proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7756 *padara gives Punjabi/Hindi pair foot and Western Pahari pɛ̃r foot. Kullui peːr foot fits this r-extension family; Turner notes alternative *padaḍa for other language forms. Exact survey form peːr is preserved.
